text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please, Assistant Trainer! Can't you go any
faster?!

A raucous crowd tightly packs the
Nakayama Racecourse stands.

Mejiro McQueen and I squeeze our way
through scores of cheering
fans as we head
to the front.

Mejiro McQueen and I squeeze our way
through scores of cheering
fans as we head
to the front.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I would never be able to forgive myself if I
were to miss Oguri's big
finish!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
In that case, shouldn't we have just kept
watching from the staff box?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As I said, I need to see her dazzling figure
in this important race up
close!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The other runners close in, but Oguri
maintains the lead! Oguri leads!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, they're about to cross the finish!
Come, take my hand!

Mejiro McQueen clasps my hand with an
emphatic grip and pulls me
through the
crowd.

Mejiro McQueen clasps my hand with an
emphatic grip and pulls me
through the
crowd.

A final tug from McQueen and in that
instant, the spectacle opens
before us.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Oguri keeps her lead for a brilliant finish!
Oguri places first! Oguri
wins!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Superstar Umamusume Oguri Cap has
done it! A miracle win in the last
race of
the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Woooow!

I'll never forget the marvel, the miracle,
that unfolded in front of my
eyes today.

I'll never forget the marvel, the miracle,
that unfolded in front of my
eyes today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Amazing... Just stunning! She really won!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: So this is what it means to be the team's ace...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
And to think she's been slumping lately.
People even started saying
she was done
for when she placed 11th in her last race...

text_block_list.name: Retiring Trainer
text_block_list.text:
When we heard folks spoutin' that
nonsense, we both knew we had to
prove
'em wrong!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are. Congratulations,
Trainer.

Our team's chief trainer approaches us.
This man has taught me
everything I know
about being a trainer.

Our team's chief trainer approaches us.
This man has taught me
everything I know
about being a trainer.

A veteran of thirty years, he's decided to
make this his last race.
However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Especially after you and Oguri
put on such a spectacular
race...
Oguri! Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Today's Oguri Chant is shaking the stands
to their very core! What an
echo!

A crowd surpassing 100,000 chant the
superstar's name.

They sing of the perfect job my mentor did
preparing her for this
race.

It's all the proof I need to know that he
still has so much yet to give...

text_block_list.name: Retiring Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Nah, that's it for me, I'm afraid. After the
long road here, this tank's
on empty.

text_block_list.name: Retiring Trainer
text_block_list.text:
So the plan's not changing. Team Sirius is
in your hands now!
Smack!

And so I'm pushed on, with a vigorous clap
on the shoulder.

And so I'm pushed on, with a vigorous clap
on the back.

Everything I know, I learned during my two
years as an assistant
trainer for Team
Sirius.

I'm about to lose my guiding light—one
that was always there in times
of weakness.

text_block_list.name: Retiring Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You do McQueen right, you hear? She's
hitting her prime with that
Kikuka Sho win!

text_block_list.name: Retiring Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Give it your all, and I know you two will
end up defining G1 races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed. You've been a tad unreliable as an assistant trainer, though, so I'll have to be the one supporting you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps you'll straighten up once I win the
spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Do look forward to it, will you?

text_block_list.name: Retiring Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Haha! She's already got you right around
her finger! But you know, I
really do
expect great things.

text_block_list.name: Retiring Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see where you take my dear
Team Sirius!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Of course!

And so, a deep crimson falls upon the turf
of Nakayama Racecourse.

And so, a deep crimson falls upon the turf
of Nakayama Racecourse.
